text: Entry Requirements Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. Residents of the Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macau or Taiwan who have emigrated to other countries and are applying to Qingdao University as international students must present valid passport or citizenship documents dating from before April 30, 2022, along with proof of cancellation of Chinese nationality. Under the age of 25. Applicants should be healthy, both physically and psychologically, with no criminal record, friendly to China and must abide by the laws and decrees of China. Applicants shall hold a senior high school diploma and have a minimum score of HSK4 180. China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) Professional Chinese for Humanities and Mathematics result are required.
